question: Who were named the ICC Players of the Month for September 2025 for their outstanding performances in international cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhishek Sharma and Smriti Mandhana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma and Smriti Mandhana were named ICC Players of the Month for September 2025 for their exceptional performances in international cricket.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhishek Sharma, aged 25, scored 314 runs in 7 matches during the Asia Cup T20I at an average of 44.85 and a strike rate of 200.**
 
• **He earned the Player of the Tournament title and reached 931 ICC Men’s T20I Batting Rating Points — the highest ever recorded in the format.**
 
• **Smriti Mandhana excelled in India’s ODI series against Australia, scoring 58, 117, and 125 in three innings, totaling 308 runs at an average of 77.**
 
• **Mandhana recorded the fastest century by an Indian batter in women’s ODIs, reaching 100 in just 50 balls.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Abhishek Sharma__

 __
 
• Age: 25 years
 
• Scored 314 runs in Asia Cup T20I 2025
 
• Strike rate: 200, Average: 44.85
 
• Recorded 931 rating points — the highest ever in ICC T20I Batting Rankings
 
 
 
• Smriti Mandhana__
 __
 
• Vice-captain of the Indian women’s cricket team
 
• Scored 308 runs in four ODI matches against Australia
 
• Achieved the fastest ODI century by an Indian woman — in just 50 balls
 
• Average: 77, Strike rate: 135.68
 
 
 
• ICC Player of the Month Awards__
 
 
• Recognizes outstanding performances by male and female cricketers each month
 
• Selected by a panel of former players, journalists, and ICC representatives
